items.name: Banana

items.name: Basil

items.name: Butter
items.desc: A condiment that unites salty and sweet and also packs a richness that makes bread a delight to eat. The finest butter products are made of 100 percent Moomoo Milk.

items.name: Cheese
items.desc: A very salty ingredient. This thinly sliced cheese is perfect for adding to a sandwich.

items.name: Cherry Tomatoes
items.desc: A very tart ingredient. Some varieties are also very sweet, and these are prized above all others by the people of Paldea.

items.name: Chili Sauce
items.desc: A condiment with a very spicy kick. It's thanks to Scovillain that this sauce gets its signature mouth- tingling burn.

items.name: Chorizo
items.desc: A very salty and spicy ingredient. This type of sausage has particularly robust salty flavor, and the spicier varieties are extra popular.

items.name: Cream Cheese
items.desc: A condiment offering very sweet and very tart flavor. It goes well with more ingredients than you'd expect, making it a convenient go-to.

items.name: Cucumber
items.desc: A tart and bitter ingredient. Using it together with rich- tasting ingredients in a sandwich will really make the most of a cucumber's fresh-veggie aroma.

items.name: Curry Powder
items.desc: A very spicy condiment. Just watch out—use too much of this potent seasoning, and it'll cancel out the other flavors.

items.name: Egg
items.desc: An ingredient with a touch of saltiness. It's full of nutrients and can be enjoyed with all sorts of seasonings.

items.name: Fried Fillet
items.desc: When used in a sandwich, this very salty and bitter ingredient is at its best paired with sour seasonings.

items.name: Green Bell Pepper
items.desc: An ingredient with some bitterness. When sliced, it adds a nice accent to a sandwich.

items.name: Ham
items.desc: A very salty ingredient—and that very saltiness is what makes it such a nice companion to veggies.

items.name: Hamburger
items.desc: This very salty ingredient is the thing to add if you want to make your sandwich truly filling.

items.name: Herbed Sausage
items.desc: A very salty and bitter ingredient. The balance between the potent saltiness and the herbs' bitterness make this sausage a pleasure.

items.name: Horseradish
items.desc: A very spicy condiment. Its distinctive sharp sizzle in your sinuses makes it a good match for rich fillings.

items.name: Jalapeno
items.desc: A very spicy ingredient—so spicy as to leave no room for ambivalence about it. You either like it or you don't.

items.name: Jam
items.desc: A condiment that's very sweet and likewise very sour. Take care when adding it to sandwiches, as the sweet side can overwhelm.

items.name: Ketchup
items.desc: A condiment with very salty and tart flavor. While a number of other ingredients go into its signature flavor, the noble tomato is its heart and soul.

items.name: Kiwi
items.desc: A very tart ingredient that has a light touch of sweetness as well. It goes well with rich ingredients.

items.name: Klawf Stick
items.desc: A very sweet and salty ingredient. It's a nutritious processed food made with a concentrate derived from shed Klawf shells.

items.name: Lettuce
items.desc: This bitter-tasting ingredient is simple and straightforward—just add it to all kinds of other ingredients for a delightfully crunchy time.

items.name: Marmalade
items.desc: A condiment with sour and bitter notes. It's surprisingly useful, as it makes a nice counterpoint to oilier foods.

items.name: Mayonnaise
items.desc: A condiment that packs a very tart punch yet pairs well with various ingredients.

items.name: Mustard
items.desc: A very spicy condiment that's indispensable when bread is on the table. It pairs tremendously with ketchup.

items.name: Noodles
items.desc: A nice salty ingredient. It's unclear how well these boiled noodles will serve as a sandwich filling.

items.name: Olive Oil
items.desc: A condiment offering faint notes of sour and bitter flavors. The most prized varieties are the ones Smoliv love the smell of—such oils' quality is assured.

items.name: Onion
items.desc: This spicy veggie is indispensable to many sandwiches. It goes well with rich ingredients.

items.name: Peanut Butter
items.desc: A very sweet condiment. People in Paldea seem to favor the sweet varieties over the unsweetened.

items.name: Pepper
items.desc: A seasoning packing very spicy flavor. It goes nicely with oilier foods and works especially well when you add just a pinch for a hint of flavor.

items.name: Pickle
items.desc: This very sour ingredient is made by pickling veggies in a flavorful brine made from spices and vinegar.

items.name: Pineapple
items.desc: This very tart ingredient is a fruit of southern lands, and its color and texture are a thrill. It's been cut into chunks to be easily manageable.

items.name: Potato Salad
items.desc: This very tart ingredient—a soft salad that's all about potatoes—pairs tremendously well with bread.

items.name: Potato Tortilla
items.desc: A very salty ingredient and a popular dish in Paldea. It's undeniably filling.

items.name: Prosciutto
items.desc: This ingredient is very salty like regular ham, but the difference is prosciutto is not cooked after it is cured, giving it a fun freshness.

items.name: Red Bell Pepper
items.desc: An ingredient with some bitterness—but its bitter notes and overall flavor are pleasantly mild compared to its green cousin.

items.name: Red Onion
items.desc: An ingredient with some sweetness to it. Its spiciness and fragrance are milder than those of other onions, making it a pleasant bite.

items.name: Rice
items.desc: An ingredient with a touch of sweetness. It's unclear how well this cooked rice will serve as a sandwich filling.

items.name: Salt
items.desc: A very salty seasoning, unsurprisingly. People quite like the grains of salt that can be gathered from the footprints of particularly jagged Naclstack.

items.name: Salty Herba Mystica
items.desc: One of the condiments spoken of as legends. Its mellow saltiness is said to be tremendously effective when it comes to promoting health.

items.name: Tofu
items.desc: An ingredient with a touch of sweetness. It's unclear how well this raw block of tofu will serve as a sandwich filling.

items.name: Tomato
items.desc: This very tart ingredient has a lot of savory elements to it, making it popular with many Pokémon.

items.name: Vinegar
items.desc: A very sour condiment. Vinegars derived from grapes are popular in Paldea. Highly effective when used to add just a light note of flavor.

items.name: Wasabi
items.desc: This very spicy condiment seems close to horseradish at first, but you'll find that it has a superb flavor all its own.

items.name: Watercress
items.desc: A very bitter ingredient that stands out among veggies for its quirky flavor. People tend to either like it or not like it—they rarely sit on the fence.

items.name: Whipped Cream
items.desc: A very sweet condiment. Folks in Paldea seem to love the varieties that really let the sweetness sing.

items.name: Yellow Bell Pepper
items.desc: An ingredient with some bitterness. It's not much different from its red counterpart in flavor, but mixing the colors makes a feast for the eyes.

items.name: Yogurt
items.desc: A condiment that's very sweet and very sour. It goes especially well with fruit and is easy to incorporate into a sandwich.

items.name: Adventure Guide
items.desc: A mysterious and convenient notebook that contains all the advice a Trainer receives out on an adventure.

items.name: Articuno Treat
items.desc: A snack made from ingredients favored by the Legendary Pokémon Articuno.

items.name: Briar's Book
items.desc: A proof copy of the exploration notes covering the Area Zero Underdepths. It's filled with long paragraphs describing what happened, along with Briar's thoughts.

items.name: Catching Charm
items.desc: Having one of these mysterious, unshakable charms makes it more likely you'll get a critical catch.

items.name: Cobalion Treat
items.desc: A snack made from ingredients favored by the Legendary Pokémon Cobalion.

items.name: Crystal Cluster
items.desc: A cluster of the crystals found within the Crystal Pool. They sparkle brilliantly and are apparently necessary to repair a certain mask.

items.name: DNA Splicers
items.desc: A splicer that fuses Kyurem and a certain Pokémon. They are said to have originally been one.

items.name: Entei Treat
items.desc: A snack made from ingredients favored by the Legendary Pokémon Entei.

items.name: Glastrier Treat
items.desc: A snack made from ingredients favored by the Legendary Pokémon Glastrier.

items.name: Glimmering Charm
items.desc: Having one of these mysterious glimmering charms increases the number of Tera Shards you receive from Tera Raid Battles.

items.name: Gracidea
items.desc: A flower sometimes bundled into a bouquet to be given as an expression of gratitude on special occasions, such as birthdays and anniversaries.

items.name: Groudon Treat
items.desc: A snack made from ingredients favored by the Legendary Pokémon Groudon.

items.name: Ho-Oh Treat
items.desc: A snack made from ingredients favored by the Legendary Pokémon Ho-Oh.

items.name: Indigo Disk
items.desc: A mysterious disk with an indigo shine to it, given to you by the Top Champion. It seems to be tied to Area Zero.

items.name: Indigo Style Card
items.desc: Having one of these cards increases the selection available to you in boutiques and hair salons.

items.name: Kofu's Wallet
items.desc: A wallet that was left behind by Kofu, the Gym Leader at the Cascarrafa Gym. You're to deliver it to him at the market in Porto Marinada.

items.name: Koraidon's Poke Ball
items.desc: A Poké Ball that can hold the mysterious Pokémon known as Koraidon. A boy named Arven gave it to you.

items.name: Kubfu Treat
items.desc: A snack made from ingredients favored by the Legendary Pokémon Kubfu.

items.name: Kyogre Treat
items.desc: A snack made from ingredients favored by the Legendary Pokémon Kyogre.

items.name: Kyurem Treat
items.desc: A snack made from ingredients favored by the Legendary Pokémon Kyurem.

items.name: Latias Treat

items.desc: A snack made from ingredients favored by the Legendary Pokémon Latios.

items.name: Lugia Treat
items.desc: A snack made from ingredients favored by the Legendary Pokémon Lugia.

items.name: Lunala Treat
items.desc: A snack made from ingredients favored by the Legendary Pokémon Lunala.

items.name: Mark Charm
items.desc: Having one of these mysterious and unique charms makes it more likely you'll encounter a Pokémon with a mark.

items.name: Meteorite
items.desc: A rock that fell to earth from space. It's slightly warm to the touch. It allows a certain species of Pokémon to change forms.

items.name: Miraidon's Poke Ball
items.desc: A Poké Ball that can hold the mysterious Pokémon known as Miraidon. A boy named Arven gave it to you.

items.name: Moltres Treat
items.desc: A snack made from ingredients favored by the Legendary Pokémon Moltres.

items.name: Mythical Pecha Berry
items.desc: A Pecha Berry of the highest quality. It's said that a Pecha Berry tree carefully tended by an expert gardener will produce just one of these Berries every few years.

items.name: N-Lunarizer
items.desc: A machine to separate Necrozma, which needed light, from Lunala.

items.name: N-Solarizer
items.desc: A machine to separate Necrozma, which needed light, from Solgaleo.

items.name: Necrozma Treat
items.desc: A snack made from ingredients favored by the Legendary Pokémon Necrozma.

items.name: Prison Bottle
items.desc: A bottle believed to have been used to seal away the power of a certain Pokémon long, long ago.

items.name: Raikou Treat
items.desc: A snack made from ingredients favored by the Legendary Pokémon Raikou.

items.name: Rayquaza Treat
items.desc: A snack made from ingredients favored by the Legendary Pokémon Rayquaza.

items.name: Reins of Unity
items.desc: Reins that people presented to the king. They enable those who are connected to communicate with each other. The reins separate Calyrex and its beloved steed.

items.name: Reshiram Treat
items.desc: A snack made from ingredients favored by the Legendary Pokémon Reshiram.

items.name: Reveal Glass
items.desc: A mysterious looking glass that reveals the truth. It can return a Pokémon to its original shape.

items.name: Roto-Stick
items.desc: A stick to rest a Rotom Phone on. It allows you to take selfies from a little bit farther away than you could on your own.

items.name: Rotom Catalog
items.desc: A catalog of devices that Rotom like. Use the catalog to have Rotom hop in and out of the various devices listed within.

items.name: Rotom Phone
items.desc: The latest model of smartphone. A Pokémon called Rotom lives within it, and it can be used to run all sorts of handy apps.

items.name: Sandwich
items.desc: A dish made by sandwiching vegetables, meat, or other ingredients between two pieces of bread. It makes a fantastic meal when out on a picnic.

items.name: Scarlet Book
items.desc: A record of the expedition that the author, Heath, went on within the Great Crater of Paldea. The book has the name “Sada” written on it in clumsy handwriting.

items.name: Shiny Charm
items.desc: Having one of these mysterious shining charms makes it more likely you'll encounter Shiny Pokémon in the wild.

items.name: Solgaleo Treat
items.desc: A snack made from ingredients favored by the Legendary Pokémon Solgaleo.

items.name: Spectrier Treat
items.desc: A snack made from ingredients favored by the Legendary Pokémon Spectrier.

items.name: Suicune Treat
items.desc: A snack made from ingredients favored by the Legendary Pokémon Suicune.

items.name: Synchro Machine
items.desc: A device that synchronizes your mind and feelings with your Pokémon's so that you can work as one. It's still a prototypeâhence its unrefined appearance.

items.name: Teal Mask
items.desc: A teal mask patterned after the face of an ogre. Ogerpon dropped it while fleeing up the stairs after visiting the Festival of Masks.

items.name: Teal Style Card
items.desc: Having one of these cards increases the selection available to you in boutiques and hair salons.

items.name: Tera Orb
items.desc: An orb that holds within it the power to crystallize. When it is charged with energy, it can be used to cause Pokémon to Terastallize.

items.name: Terrakion Treat
items.desc: A snack made from ingredients favored by the Legendary Pokémon Terrakion.

items.name: Violet Book
items.desc: A record of the expedition that the author, Heath, went on within the Great Crater of Paldea. The book has the name “Turo” written on it in clumsy handwriting.
